subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned user facts be a first-class Control UI memory surface, and if so what storage and injection contract should OpenClaw own?
rationale: The issue asks for UI write-back into always-injected context, which intersects memory ownership, stale fact handling, security/privacy, and whether the broader memory panel or plugin-panel seam should own the UX.

options.title: Design first-class pinned facts
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify a dedicated pinned-facts model, previewed write-back UX, and guaranteed injection rules before implementation.

options.title: Fold into the memory panel
options.body: Treat pinned facts as a subfeature of the broader Control UI memory editor tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/46809.

options.title: Defer to plugin panel APIs
options.body: Wait for a generic Control UI panel extension seam and let a memory/plugin owner provide the pinned-facts experience.

recommendation.title: Design first-class pinned facts
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify a dedicated pinned-facts model, previewed write-back UX, and guaranteed injection rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision spans product/security boundary, memory behavior, and Gateway/Control UI contracts, and history shows adjacent ownership across those areas.
